---
title: "AI Engineering Lab"
description: "Learning AI engineering through small experiments and measured comparisons."
---

I use small, reproducible experiments to understand embeddings, search, and retrieval systems. Each notebook records the question, implementation, result, and next engineering decision.

## Embeddings and search

- [Text Embeddings and Semantic Search](embeddings-and-search/01-text-embeddings.ipynb) builds a song search engine and compares a keyword baseline with embedding retrieval.
- [A Content-Based Song Recommender](embeddings-and-search/02-content-based-recommender.ipynb) uses three liked songs to recommend unheard songs and inspects the limits of text-based preference vectors.

The [source notebooks and song dataset](https://github.com/lakpa/ai-engineering-lab/tree/main/embeddings-and-search) are available in the repository.
